name: Shinohara Nao
source:
She was once Yuichiro's private tutor, but from then on he began training her as a female slave. Although she quit her job as a private tutor and their relationship ended, she was once again sent to the school Yuichiro attended as a teacher, leading to a life as a slave once again.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/onnakyoushi/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
